Blue Staffordshire Bull Terriers are renowned for being incredibly loyal, affectionate, and patient companions, earning them the nickname “nanny dog.” Their loving nature makes them excellent additions to families, thriving on human interaction and forming strong bonds with children when properly socialised.
With consistent Staffy puppy care and positive training from an early age, their loving temperament truly shines.
A healthy blue Staffy typically has a life expectancy of 12 to 14 years , though many live even longer with proper care.
As KC registered Staffy breeders , we prioritise extensive health screening to ensure our puppies are as robust as possible, reducing the risk of hereditary conditions.
Aggression in any dog breed typically stems from poor socialization, lack of training, or past negative experiences, not their inherent nature.
We encourage responsible Staffy puppy care and continuous positive training to help your Staffy thrive as a well-adjusted family member.
While they can be trained to tolerate short periods of being alone (e.g., 2-4 hours for an adult dog), they are not a breed that should be left in isolation for extended durations.
However, they can also be strong-willed, requiring consistent and firm training from a young age.
Early socialisation and positive reinforcement methods work best.
As mentioned on our About Us page, we focus on early socialisation to give our puppies a great start.
Adult dogs typically sleep around 12-14 hours a day, often including naps during the day.
Puppies, including Staffy puppies, tend to sleep even more, around 18-20 hours, to support their growth and development.
